banners.returnRequested: Your payment return request has been sent. Whether the money is returned depends on the recipient’s cooperation and can’t be guaranteed. You can request their contact details from {0}.
banners.idAvailable: It’s been more than 7 days since you submitted your payment return request. You can now request the account holder’s contact details.
banners.idRequested: We’ve sent your payment return request and your request for contact details. The recipient’s bank will handle the next steps.

returnIntro.title: Sent money to the wrong account? Request it back
returnIntro.requestDescription: We’ll send your request to the recipient’s bank, which will notify the account holder. This service can’t be used for payments to fraudulent online shops or marketplace sites.
returnIntro.waitTitle: Wait for the recipient to respond
returnIntro.waitDescription: The recipient’s bank can’t decide whether the money is returned. It’s up to the account holder who received the payment.
returnIntro.detailsTitle: If the recipient doesn’t respond, you can request their contact details after 7 days
returnIntro.detailsDescription: If the money isn’t returned, you can request the recipient’s contact details. You can then contact them directly.
returnIntro.disclaimer: Returning the payment depends on the recipient’s cooperation and can’t be guaranteed.

idIntro.title: Request the recipient’s contact details
idIntro.description: We’ll send your request to the recipient’s bank, which will decide whether to provide you with the recipient’s contact details.
idIntro.waitedTitle: You waited for the recipient to respond
idIntro.detailsTitle: The recipient hasn’t responded, so you can now request their contact details
idIntro.detailsDescription: If the money hasn’t been returned, you can request the recipient’s contact details. You can then contact them directly.
idIntro.disclaimer: Whether the contact details can be provided depends on the recipient’s bank and can’t be guaranteed.

lowAmount.title: A payment return request costs {0}. Do you still want to continue?
lowAmount.description: The amount you’re trying to recover is close to the processing fee. Please consider whether you still want to submit the request.

tooEarly.title: You can request the recipient’s contact details from {0}
tooEarly.description: We’ve sent your payment return request to the recipient’s bank. You can request the recipient’s contact details 7 calendar days after submitting the request.
tooEarly.disclaimer: Returning the payment depends on the recipient’s cooperation and can’t be guaranteed.

wait.title: We’ve sent your payment return request and your request for contact details. The recipient’s bank will handle the next steps
wait.description:
We’ll let you know the outcome in a message in Internet Banka.
You can find confirmation that we received your request in Smart Banka and Internet Banka under Documents.

account.title: Enter the account the payment should have been sent to. You can also add an attachment for verification
account.description: You can attach a document showing which account the payment was meant for, such as an invoice, order or payment instructions.
account.disclaimer: Returning the payment depends on the recipient’s cooperation and can’t be guaranteed.

error.description: This is the account you sent the payment to. Enter the account it should have been sent to instead.
error.disclaimer: Returning the payment depends on the recipient’s cooperation and can’t be guaranteed. The request costs {0}.

upload.title: Upload a document showing which account the payment should have been sent to
upload.description: This could be an invoice, order or payment instructions.
upload.fileTooLarge: The file is too large. The maximum size is 10 MB.

returnContacts.title: Would you like to share your contact details with the recipient’s bank?
returnContacts.description: Sharing your contact details is optional. They’ll only be used by the recipient’s bank to process your request.
returnContacts.toggleTitle: Share contact details with the recipient’s bank

idContacts.title: Would you like the recipient to be able to contact you directly?
idContacts.description:
You only need to provide the details you want to share, such as your phone number or email address.
These details may be shared with the recipient’s bank and the account holder to process your request.

summary.shouldBeSentToAccount: Payment should have been sent to
summary.idFeeDisclaimer: Whether the details can be provided depends on the recipient’s bank and can’t be guaranteed.
summary.returnDeclaration: I confirm that the recipient account number in the payment order was incorrect and the payment should have been sent to a different account.
summary.idDeclaration: I declare that I sent the payment to an incorrect account and that I will use the requested identification details solely to claim the return of the incorrectly sent funds. I acknowledge that providing false information may have legal consequences.

documents.paymentReturnDeclaration: Review your payment return request and confirm your declaration
documents.paymentIdApplication: Review your request for the recipient’s details
documents.description: You can find all documents in Smart Banka and Internet Banka under Documents.

returnRequested.title: We’ve sent your payment return request to the recipient’s bank, which will pass it on to the account holder
returnRequested.description: You can find confirmation that we received your request in Smart Banka and Internet Banka under Documents.
returnRequested.waitTitle: Wait for the recipient to respond
returnRequested.waitDescription: The recipient’s bank doesn’t decide whether the payment is returned. The decision is up to the account holder who received it.
returnRequested.detailsTitle: If the recipient doesn’t respond, you can request their contact details after 7 days
returnRequested.detailsDescription: If the money hasn’t been returned, you can request the recipient’s contact details the same way. You can then contact them directly.

idRequested.title: We’ve sent your request for contact details to the recipient’s bank
idRequested.description:
